candidates.title: Gemini Robotics 2
candidates.why_candidate: Official July 30 release expands whole-body, dexterous and cross-robot VLA control with extensive demos and model cards.

candidates.title: CLAP: Cross-Embodiment Video World Models are Zero-Shot Physical Simulators
candidates.why_candidate: Open cross-embodiment action-conditioned video world model with code, checkpoints, and policy-in-the-loop deployment.

candidates.title: SpatialCrafter: Single Image World Modeling with Generative 3D Proxies
candidates.why_candidate: SIGGRAPH Asia system generates controllable, persistent explorable worlds from one image via a global 3D proxy.

candidates.title: PAWBench: How Far Are We from Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?
candidates.why_candidate: Introduces distributional evaluation of possible physical futures rather than scoring isolated rollouts.

candidates.title: R2M-Bench: Evaluating Revisit Memory via Relative Consistency in Interactive Video World Models
candidates.why_candidate: Adds shortcut-resistant memory evaluation for leave-and-return interactive rollouts.

candidates.title: 4DSynth: Controllable Procedural World Synthesis for Dynamic Embodied Simulation
candidates.why_candidate: Produces editable physics-ready 4D scenes and a procedural navigation benchmark.

candidates.title: Riemann-1.0: An Embodied World Action Model for Physical AI
candidates.why_candidate: Unified causal policy/simulator trained on a reported 200K+ hours of heterogeneous interaction data.

candidates.title: Do Robotic World Models Really Follow Actions? Diagnosing and Aligning Action-Conditioned Generation for Policy Learning
candidates.why_candidate: WorldEcho diagnoses off-expert action following and WorldSync aligns action-conditioned futures.

candidates.title: From Generation to Simulation: How Far Are World Models from Being True Simulators?
candidates.why_candidate: Capability-based survey and evidence map for simulator substitution.

triage.reason: Official high-impact VLA release with inspectable multi-robot and whole-body demos.
Open models/code and direct world-action relevance clear fast-track gates.
Peer-reviewed interactive generation system with strong official qualitative gallery.
Distinct distributional benchmark with code/project surface and eleven-model diagnosis.
Useful, focused interactive-memory benchmark with calibrated metrics and seven-model evaluation.
Direct generation/simulation fit, but official visual surface could not be located.
Very high reported scale and performance, but official physical-demo surface is insufficient.
Strong action-following diagnostic, but physical/generated evidence needs human inspection.
Useful related-work evidence map, but a survey does not itself add executable infrastructure and remains below impact gate.
